development_selection.gate: Both target-macro nDCG@10 and Kendall tau must have target-bootstrap CI lower bounds above zero and Holm-adjusted exact target sign-flip p<0.05 in leave-one-development-target-out validation.

power_analysis.note: The sample-size approximation uses a paired-normal approximation and is planning guidance, not a post-hoc proof of power.

scientific_conclusion.summary: The frozen target-held-out evaluation does not support a superiority claim; the median-potency guardrail remains deployed.
